paragraphs.text: The Riverside Food Bank needs volunteers to sort donations and pack food parcels. Shifts last three hours, and volunteers must be at least 16. No experience is needed, and training is given on the first day.

Hope House, a care home for older people, is looking for volunteers to chat with residents and help with activities such as quizzes and gardening. Volunteers must agree to visit at least once a week for six months.
The Town Museum wants volunteers to welcome visitors and lead tours. Volunteers should have an interest in local history and must attend a two-day course before they start.
Hope House and the Town Museum both ask volunteers for the names of two people who can recommend them. The Food Bank is the only one of the three that offers weekend shifts.
Anyone interested in any of these roles should first contact the volunteer centre, which is based in the town library.

items.quote: Volunteers must agree to visit at least once a week for six months

explanation.en: Hope House asks volunteers to come “at least once a week for six months” → B. Food Bank shifts have no such commitment.
explanation.kk: Hope House «at least once a week for six months» келуді сұрайды → B. Food Bank ауысымдары қысқа әрі міндетсіз.
explanation.ru: Hope House просит приходить «at least once a week for six months» → B. Смены в Food Bank короткие и без обязательств.

items.prompt: has a minimum age for volunteers

explanation.en: The Food Bank: “volunteers must be at least 16” → A. “Three hours” is the shift length.
explanation.kk: Food Bank: «volunteers must be at least 16» → A. «Three hours» — ауысым ұзақтығы.
explanation.ru: Food Bank: «volunteers must be at least 16» → A. «Three hours» — длина смены.

items.quote: must attend a two-day course before they start

explanation.en: The museum: “must attend a two-day course before they start” → C. The Food Bank trains on the first day, not beforehand.
explanation.kk: Мұражай: «must attend a two-day course before they start» → C. Food Bank-те алдын ала емес, бірінші күні оқытады.
explanation.ru: Музей: «must attend a two-day course before they start» → C. В Food Bank обучают в первый день, а не заранее.

items.quote: The Food Bank is the only one of the three that offers weekend shifts
items.prompt: is the only one with weekend work

explanation.en: “The Food Bank is the only one of the three that offers weekend shifts” → A. A is used twice — there is an NB.
explanation.kk: «The Food Bank is the only one of the three that offers weekend shifts» → A. A екінші рет — NB бар.
explanation.ru: «The Food Bank is the only one of the three that offers weekend shifts» → A. A второй раз — есть NB.

items.quote: help with activities such as quizzes and gardening
items.prompt: involves outdoor activities with the people it cares for

explanation.en: At Hope House volunteers help with activities such as “gardening” with residents → B.
explanation.kk: Hope House-та «gardening» сияқты іске көмектеседі — тұрғындармен бақта жұмыс → B.
explanation.ru: В Hope House помогают с занятиями вроде «gardening» — работа в саду с жильцами → B.
